propositions: The gated-close process lacks direct timing instrumentation for intermediate phases before completion verdict, forcing large unattributed residual intervals in the duration probe.

Adding ten direct millisecond-level timing fields to COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics requires only time.monotonic_ns(), integer arithmetic, and dictionary assignments on the existing call path with no I/O, subprocess, network, tracker, or model overhead.

Direct phase timings must be piggybacked on the existing sidecar write and propagate through the same close helper graph without modifying caller contracts or breaking existing callers that supply no timing dictionary.
The duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present, labeling records lacking them as legacy_uninstrumented without assigning a causal name to their residual interval.
Instrumentation must be validated to add less than 50 microseconds per close via standard-library ABBA CPU-time microbenchmark with existing Git/model/I/O work stubbed.
All existing completion consumption metrics, subprocess counts, and sidecar calls must remain present and unchanged after instrumentation lands.
